1.title: Why Our Poll Shows Democrats Leading in the House
1.summary: Our polling reporter Ruth Igielnik describes what likely voters told us in the latest Times/Siena poll leading up to this year’s midterm elections.

2.title: U.S. Has Deployed Weapons in Space, Air Force Secretary Says
2.summary: Troy E. Meink’s comments were the first public acknowledgment of American weapons in orbit. The Pentagon has been preparing for potential conflict in space with Russia or China.

3.title: With Trump’s Plans Blocked, States Work to Restore Trust in Mail Voting
3.summary: President Trump’s efforts to restrict mail voting ahead of the midterms were thwarted by the Supreme Court, but they have sowed confusion and doubt among some voters.

4.title: Denmark says Russian warship fired flares at military helicopter
4.summary: The Danish prime minister has accused Russia of "reckless" behaviour, while the Kremlin is yet to comment.

5.title: Suspected sabotage causes major Netherlands rail disruption
5.summary: Trains were cancelled or delayed on Tuesday after objects were found on tracks at multiple locations.

6.title: It’s Boom Time in Kyrgyzstan, Courtesy in Part of the War in Ukraine
6.summary: The economy of the Central Asian nation grew by 11 percent last year, partly by becoming a key conduit for goods flowing into Russia.
